title: Claude Cowork: Web, Mobile, and Remote Sessions
content:
## Overview

**Cowork** is Anthropic's agentic workspace product where Claude works through longer, multi-step tasks (research, drafting, file organization, coding-adjacent work) with a human checking in periodically rather than driving every turn. On July 7, 2026, Anthropic expanded Cowork from desktop-only to **web and mobile (iOS and Android)**, and began rolling out **remote sessions** in beta.

---

## What Changed

Before this rollout, a Cowork session ran on the user's desktop machine and needed the app open and the machine on to keep working. As of the July 2026 expansion:

- Cowork is available as a **web app** and on **iOS/Android**, not just desktop.
- **Remote sessions (beta)** run on Anthropic's servers instead of the user's device. Session state and files are saved to the user's Claude account, so a session started on desktop can be checked, resumed, or approved from a phone or browser.
- Work **continues after the laptop is closed** — a genuine shift from "agent tethered to my machine" to "agent runs independently and notifies me."
- **Scheduled tasks** can run with no device online at all, since execution happens server-side.

---

## Rollout Details

- Remote sessions beta started with **Max plan subscribers** on July 7, 2026.
- Broader availability is rolling out over subsequent weeks with no fixed announced schedule for other plan tiers.

---

## Why It Matters

The core interaction shift is away from babysitting a running task toward a check-in model: describe the desired outcome, let Claude work remotely, and come back when Claude needs a decision or has output ready for review. Users get **push notifications** when Claude is blocked on a decision or has finished a step that needs approval — conceptually similar to how Claude Code's own scheduled/background sessions notify a user, but extended to Cowork's broader task types (not just coding).

This pairs with the general 2026 trend across Anthropic's product line toward **agent-style, long-horizon execution**: Claude Code's background sessions and scheduled tasks, and now Cowork's remote sessions, both move toward "describe the goal, get pinged when input is needed" rather than a synchronous chat loop.

---

## Cowork vs. Claude Code

| | Cowork | Claude Code |
|---|---|---|
| Primary domain | General knowledge work (docs, research, files, office formats) | Software engineering (repos, shell, git) |
| Session location | Desktop, web, mobile; remote (beta) runs on Anthropic servers | Local machine, or cloud container for web/mobile sessions |
| Trigger model | Interactive + scheduled tasks | Interactive, scheduled tasks, background/subagent sessions |
| Notification on blocking decision | Push notification | Task notification / PushNotification tool in scheduled runs |

---

## Open Questions

- Pricing and quota details for remote (server-side) execution versus local desktop execution are still being clarified as the beta expands past Max subscribers.
- Enterprise controls (the same DLP/inference-hooks work rolling out elsewhere in the Claude product line) are expected to extend to Cowork's remote sessions, since remote execution means prompts and tool calls now route through Anthropic infrastructure rather than staying on-device.
